missionPremise: Operator Nick ruled 2026-08-31 'retire pe-billing.ts'. The install-scoped seam POST /api/brokerage/v1/property-explorer/billing/checkout resolves stripePriceIdForTier to STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID, the retired pre-ladder Pro price, so any request reaching it opens a Stripe checkout at an amount that is not on the locked ladder. hauska-map PR #325 retired the client half under P-97 and explicitly named the two BFF paths it left. Source: _dispatches/2026-09-01_p103-seam_dispatch.md and the doc_repo scope correction committed at 41278c7.
completionPredicate: api/pe-billing.ts, the vercel.json rewrite, the vite.config.ts dev proxy entry, and the 'api/brokerage/v1/property-explorer/billing' entry in cortexPostPaths are all gone from apps/property-explorer; a guard in the repo's existing check set fails if any of the four reappears and has been observed failing in all four directions; the deployed host declines /api/pe-billing with a 404 after the planner deploys.
scopeBasis: api/ and config in apps/property-explorer only. apps/property-explorer/src/browse/SettingsModal.tsx and apps/property-explorer/src/lib/* are held by other lanes (hauska-map-settings on fix/pe-settings-line-weight, hauska-map-nextaction on feat/p98b-account-entitlement-client) and are excluded by the dispatch. legacy-design-tools is another seat's repo and is read-only here. STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID stays in Secret Manager and in the workflow per acceptance item 6, because unsetting it turns brokerageStripe.ts:174 into a mode:'simulated' fail-open, a wider blast radius than the card.

A blanket grep would be permanently red (DEV_PROCESS 2.0) or would force an edit this lane is forbidden to make. The guard is scoped to four structural facts instead.

gradingCorrectionVerifiedIndependently.sourceEvidence: apps/property-explorer/api/spine.ts:310-318 places the isCortexBrowsePathAllowed 403 ABOVE the cortexPostPaths block. isCortexBrowsePathAllowed (lines 137-153) allows POST for exactly four upstream paths: api/brokerage/v1/place/buildable-envelope, api/brokerage/v1/map-data, api/brokerage/v1/map-data/gis-layer, api/brokerage/v1/map-data/composite-layer. The billing prefix is not among them, and cortexPostPaths is declared inside the same 'cortex' branch, so it is unreachable for that path.

liveEvidenceBefore.meaning: Production TODAY carries the billing prefix in cortexPostPaths and still declines. The entry is a config permission that has never fired.

notVacuousControl.meaning: The 403 above is not a blanket refuser. An allowed POST passes the gate and reaches upstream cortex, which answers with its own zod validation error. The gate discriminates.

gradingCorrectionVerifiedIndependently.consequenceForGrading: Removing the cortexPostPaths entry closes NO exploitable path. It removes config that reads as a live permission and that a later relaxation of the browse gate would silently make live. The close must not report it as closing an exploitable path.

pathALivenessVerifiedBefore.meaning: That JSON is emitted by pe-billing.ts lines 42-48, not by Vercel. The function is deployed and reachable from the internet.
pathALivenessVerifiedBefore.secondOwnCodeProbe: POST https://smartsite.cloud/api/pe-billing?path=bogus returns 400 {"error":"invalid path"} from pe-billing.ts lines 11-14.
pathALivenessVerifiedBefore.discriminator: POST https://smartsite.cloud/api/pe-not-a-real-route returns 404 'The page could not be found / NOT_FOUND'. An absent api route and a present one are distinguishable, so the post-deploy 404 will be a real decline rather than a catch-all rendering.
pathALivenessVerifiedBefore.whyThisProbeAndNotACheckout: A probe carrying an install id of 8 or more characters would reach the upstream seam and fire recordGtmEvent, syncPipedriveDeal, and a Stripe checkout session creation. That is an outward-facing mutation and is never batched into a go. The header-less probe proves liveness entirely from the function's own code with zero upstream contact.
